evals.name: rewrite-vague-issue
evals.prompt: Rewrite evals/files/vague-issue.md as an issue another agent can implement without asking me anything. The code is in evals/files/notes-app/.
evals.expected_output: A feature-sized brief whose facts cite notes/export.py and notes/store.py, which corrects both false review claims, keeps sync as an open decision instead of designing it, and has numbered acceptance criteria with how each is verified.
expectations: The reply states the size of the work
The brief records a commit the facts were read at, or says the folder is not a git repository
A 'What exists today' section names export_csv and EXPORT_COLUMNS in notes/export.py and NoteStore in notes/store.py
The brief says the claim that export_csv already writes tags is false: EXPORT_COLUMNS is id, title, body
The brief says the claim that notes are saved to SQLite is false: NoteStore keeps notes in memory
Sync between devices is listed as an open decision or a separate outcome with a recommendation, and no step designs or implements sync
There is a 'Stop and ask' section with at least two conditions
Acceptance criteria are numbered and each has a 'How it is verified' entry naming a test or command
At least one test to write first is about tags in the export and points at an acceptance criterion
The reply asks the owner to decide the open question before the sync part is written as steps

evals.name: small-fix-stays-small
evals.prompt: Write an issue for another agent: in evals/files/notes-app the export header should say "note_id" instead of "id".
evals.expected_output: A short small-fix brief naming EXPORT_COLUMNS in notes/export.py, the existing test that asserts the header, and one or two acceptance criteria with how they are verified.
expectations: The reply states the work is a small fix
The brief names EXPORT_COLUMNS in notes/export.py
The brief notes that tests/test_export.py asserts the old header and must change
Acceptance criteria are numbered and each says how it is verified
The brief has no Decisions, Sequence or Slice sections
The brief is under 40 lines

evals.name: decision-before-steps
evals.prompt: Make an issue so a cheaper model can add a size limit to note bodies in evals/files/notes-app. Not sure what the limit should be.
evals.expected_output: The reply finds the existing MAX_NOTE_CHARS limit of 2000 in notes/store.py, reports it, and asks whether to change it before writing implementation steps.
expectations: The reply says a limit already exists: MAX_NOTE_CHARS = 2000 in notes/store.py, enforced in save_note
The reply asks the owner what the limit should be, or whether the existing one is enough, with a recommendation
No implementation steps depend on a limit value the owner has not chosen
Any acceptance criteria written say how they are verified
